correctness.rationale: The optimizer is the perpendicular free sum of a regular triangle and two antipodal pairs; all 12 tetrahedral facet determinants have magnitude sqrt(3)/2 and signs stable locally. Multilinearity of 1/24 times oriented determinants and the normalized tangent chart gives the exact diagonal and cross-coordinate Hessian formulas; first derivative vanishes. An independently rebuilt symbolic 21x21 Hessian has characteristic polynomial lambda^6(lambda+sqrt(3)/8)^6(lambda+sqrt(3)/6)^2(lambda+sqrt(3)/4)^3(lambda+7sqrt(3)/24)^4, with zero gradient and volume sqrt(3)/4. Six independent rotational infinitesimal fields span the entire nullspace. On the normal bundle to the compact SO4 orbit the least absolute negative eigenvalue is sqrt(3)/8; tubular Taylor and chord-versus-geodesic comparison give 1/2 of that =sqrt(3)/16, attained by geodesic along its eigenvector. No explicit uniform neighborhood radius or global modulus follows.
